meaning: A place on your phone where you can find and download apps. Some apps are free and some cost money.
clues: It is a store you carry in your pocket.
You search for what you want, read the reviews, and tap a button to get it.
iPhones use one run by Apple. Android phones use one called Google Play.
Its pages show pictures of each app, star ratings, and what other people say.
It has two words. The first is the short word for what it sells, and the second is where you shop.
assumes: An operating system is the main software that runs a phone
A web browser is a program for visiting websites
A mobile game is a video game made for a phone

decoys.meaning: The main software that runs a phone or computer, such as Android or iOS.
A program you use to visit websites, such as Chrome or Safari.
A video game made to be played on a phone.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: I came home in a box from a real shop. You carried me out like a loaf of bread!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: download only from your phone's own store, and read a few reviews first. Skip anything with very few ratings.
